title: Sapient
summary: Self-custody wallet for Ootle mainnet and Esmeralda. November 28, 2026: Android 0.11.4 was published today for Android 10 or newer. The creator reports Ootle 0.57 support through Ootle SDK 0.7.0, a fix for new-wallet Home screens retaining a testnet address after switching to mainnet, and a Receive shortcut when Send has no tokens. Chrome version 0.11.3 was last observed November 27; Android and extension versions are tracked separately. The older store overview says testnet-only, while the creator site documents mainnet and Esmeralda switching. Firefox and iOS submissions are not treated as available store releases. Review covered primary release notes and repository text; no package, extension, wallet or transaction was operated. The recording shows the Android 0.11.4 announcement.
cardSummary: Manage Ootle accounts with Sapient’s browser wallet, or explore its Android release with NFT and token tools.
